snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 085 - The Sengoku Bushou - Tenka Touitsu no Yabou (2002)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The Sengoku Bushou is a Strategy game, developed by Siesta and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2002.
